meta.title: 有辨识度的面部平衡
meta.title_en: Facial Balance That Still Looks Like You
meta.topic: 医美 · 面部美学 · 平衡

scenes.title_cn: 辨识度来自平衡，不是标准脸
scenes.title_en: Distinction Comes from Balance, Not a Standard Face
scenes.context: 很多人以为美的目标是『标准脸』，但真正的辨识度恰恰来自平衡下的个体特征。完全标准的脸反而记不住。
sentences: 辨识度来自平衡，而不是标准。
Distinction comes from balance, not from being standard.
distinction（辨识度）
完全标准的脸，反而记不住。
A perfectly standard face is the one you forget.
standard face（标准脸）
真正的辨识度，是平衡下的个体特征。
True distinction is your individual features under balance.
individual features（个体特征）
paraphrase: Convention is memorable; a perfect face is forgettable.
Balance is the stage that lets your features shine.
scenes.speak: Distinction comes from balance, not from being standard. A perfectly standard face is the one you forget. True distinction is your individual features under balance.

scenes.title_cn: 平衡的检验：五眼与三庭的相对关系
scenes.title_en: Testing Balance: Relative Thirds and Fifths
scenes.context: 三庭五眼不是绝对标尺，而是检验工具：看五官分布是否让视觉重心落在舒适区。轻微不对称是辨识度的一部分，不用修到绝对对称。
sentences: 三庭五眼不是标尺，是检验工具。
The thirds and fifths aren't a ruler — they're a test.
test（检验）
视觉重心落在哪里，比绝对值更重要。
Where the visual focus falls matters more than the numbers.
visual focus（视觉重心）
轻微的不对称，是辨识度的一部分。
Mild asymmetry is part of what makes you distinct.
asymmetry（不对称）
paraphrase: Use the canon to diagnose, not to build.
Perfect symmetry can look more robotic than beautiful.
scenes.speak: The thirds and fifths aren't a ruler — they're a test. Where the visual focus falls matters more than the numbers. Mild asymmetry is part of what makes you distinct.

scenes.title_cn: 设计结论：先保特征，再谈调整
scenes.title_en: The Takeaway: Preserve the Feature, Then Adjust
scenes.context: 设计方案时，先把让你『像自己』的特征保护起来，再围绕平衡做微调。丢掉特征的方案，无论多标准都不是有效设计。
sentences: 先把让你像自己的特征保护起来。
First, protect what makes you look like you.
protect（保护）
再围绕平衡做微调。
Then fine-tune around balance.
fine-tune（微调）
丢掉特征的方案，再标准也不是有效设计。
A plan that erases your features isn't effective design, no matter how standard.
erases your features（抹掉特征）
paraphrase: Your signature features come before any adjustment.
scenes.speak: First, protect what makes you look like you. Then fine-tune around balance. A plan that erases your features isn't effective design, no matter how standard.
